environment: Real built React UI in Chromium; explicit API route fixtures with 500 sites, one pool/host/VM per site. All inventory and creation responses simulated; no Controller or libvirt execution.
checks: One closed control opens focused popup search; 500 options scroll within bounds; search/clear/no-match and arrows/Enter/Escape preserve correct selection and focus
Outside click and Tab dismiss the popup without trapping or stealing keyboard focus
Explicit site changes filter all three resource levels; global task navigation and reload preserve selected site
Pool, host and VM deep links select their owning site on navigation/reload; in-page route change also updates the tree
Popup search, long names and selection remain reachable at 360px without horizontal page overflow
An absent saved site falls back to the first available site on reload
Empty inventory offers site creation; successful fixture creation selects its new route without unrelated resources
The sole default site with no pools can open Site overview from workspace/tasks and exposes Create pool
limits: Browser navigation/presentation only; no backend authorization or native-host claim
No deployment or hosted CI execution
